chat.text: English quality fine, Arabic burning. v2.4 went out 35 min before the page.
Should I roll back or wait for the evaluation team?
Our offline set has no Eastern Arabic digits at all.
The template change in v2.4 dropped the digit normalisation step.

summary: After the v2.4 model update, Arabic tracking questions with Eastern Arabic digits returned other customers' parcel records.

timeline.event: Model v2.4 released to all traffic after the offline evaluation passed (English set only).
Arabic quality burn-rate alert pages the on-call engineer.
Customer services report wrong parcel statuses from Arabic customers.
Incident declared; Thabit Al-Junaibi takes the incident lead role.
A customer reports another person's delivery address in an answer.
Model rolled back to v2.3; Arabic answers recover within five minutes.
2.1% of Arabic answers since the release named a parcel the customer did not ask about.
Parcel numbers written in Eastern Arabic digits were not normalised by the v2.4 prompt template; the tracking lookup fell back to the nearest match.
Breach assessed: 40 answers exposed another customer's name and address; harm is likely; SDAIA to be notified and the customers told.
Notification sent to SDAIA through the national platform; customers informed by text message.
